shared_constraints: Create one isolated game asset only, centered, fully visible, no crop. Crisp hand-placed pixel art with a deliberately low internal pixel resolution, no antialiasing, no smooth vector edges, no painterly texture, no photorealism. Use the attached approved draft reference as the exact design, palette, 3/4 top-down camera, and upper-left light guide. Flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow spill, particles, border, text, letters, numbers, labels, logo, signature, or watermark. Do not use magenta anywhere in the asset itself.

prompts.player_idle_south: The cyan non-attacking blessing mage player in a neutral idle pose facing south/front in fixed 3/4 top-down view. Empty hands held visibly away from the body; no weapon. Preserve the cyan hood, white accents, short mantle, compact four-head-tall silhouette, and readable feet.
prompts.dasher_idle_south: The coral-red charging knight enemy in a neutral idle pose facing south/front in fixed 3/4 top-down view. Preserve the forward helmet crest, broad shoulders, compact shield, lance-like charge weapon, pale-gold accents, and wedge-shaped charging silhouette.
prompts.archer_idle_south: The violet piercing archer enemy in a neutral ready pose facing south/front in fixed 3/4 top-down view. Preserve the hood, lavender accents, and long asymmetrical bow with a clearly readable horizontal firing axis.
prompts.minion_idle_south: The compact green dungeon minion in a neutral idle pose facing south/front in fixed 3/4 top-down view. Preserve the small rounded-square head-and-body silhouette, short limbs, simple clothing, and clearly smaller scale than humanoids.
prompts.soul_pickup: A single cyan-white soul shard pickup: compact faceted diamond-flame silhouette, bright cyan core and pale outline, readable at 32 pixels, no character and no pedestal.
prompts.exit_closed: A single closed gold diamond exit marker in fixed 3/4 top-down view: faceted golden diamond hovering just above a compact dark blue-gray octagonal stone base, restrained pale-gold trim, no open portal hole and no particles.
prompts.blessing_haste_icon: A single Haste blessing icon: cyan-white stack of three forward chevrons crossed by one narrow lightning bolt, strong asymmetric speed silhouette, readable at 32 and 64 pixels, no frame and no character.
prompts.blessing_giant_icon: A single Giant blessing icon: heavy red-orange concentric hexagon with a solid central stone cube, thick weight-bearing silhouette, readable at 32 and 64 pixels, no frame and no character.
prompts.dungeon_floor_tile: A single square low-contrast blue-gray stone floor tile in fixed 3/4 top-down visual language but presented as a seamless square texture. Subtle four-stone pattern, uniform edge values so all four sides repeat seamlessly, no perspective border, no prop and no gold accent.
